data.name: Image Pakistan Limited
data.description: Image Pakistan Limited was incorporated in Pakistan, as a public limited company on November 14, 1990 under the Companies Ordinance, 1984 (Repealed with the enactment of the Companies Act, 2017 on May 30, 2017). The principal activity of the Company is manufacturing and sale of embroidered fabric and ready-to-wear garments under the brand name Image which is a high street retail fashion brand.
